notes: Text version of the nightly steps. Same model, endpoint and pinned provider as config/openrouter.json; no images are sent.
Thinking is on only for reflector_text, as for the paper reflector. marking runs without thinking.
The 1800-second timeout and the output-token caps are caller safeguards, not paper settings. A truncated answer is rejected, not repaired.

timeout_seconds was 600 until 2026-11-16. The reflector reads a whole 1,800-line morning record (about 50k input tokens, thinking on); on night 1 no answer came within 600 seconds (about $0.028 billed, answer lost), so the limit was raised to 1800.
chunking (2026-11-18) turns a day's record into chunks of what the person does; no thinking and temperature 0, like marking. The 8192-token cap is a caller safeguard.
